description: Find and compare current prices for products and for plans and subscriptions to software, AI tools and services, with pricing tiers, fees, rates, tariffs and usage-based pricing such as per-seat, per-hour or per-token API costs, from official pricing pages and store listings, with live deals, stock, delivery and reviews. Use for how much something costs, price checks, plan and tier comparisons, the cheapest option, sales and holiday deals such as Black Friday and Cyber Monday, and whether a deal is real, even without naming a tool, since prices change often.
